sources.title: On the English edition of Van Rheede’s Hortus Malabaricus by K.S. Manilal (2003)
sources.author: H. Y. Mohan Ram
sources.note: Authoritative Current Science review of Manilal’s 12-volume English Hortus — useful orientation for non-specialists.

sources.title: A Study on the Role of Itty Achuden in the Compilation of Hortus Malabaricus
sources.author: K. S. Manilal
sources.note: Chapter (pp. 41–75) from Hortus Malabaricus and the Socio-Cultural Heritage of India. Local copy of the Internet Archive PDF (item manilal2003 / manilal2.pdf); Original URL opens the IA item page.

sources.title: Hortus Indicus Malabaricus (Latin original) — Biodiversity Heritage Library
sources.author: Hendrik van Rheede et al.
sources.note: BHL bibliography hub for the Latin Hortus volumes with page-level viewing and PDF generation. Prefer this over fragile third-party mirrors.

sources.title: Hortus Indicus Malabaricus — Volume 1 (Internet Archive)
sources.author: Hendrik van Rheede
sources.note: Stable public-domain scan of Vol. 1. Good fallback when Rainforest Initiative volume links break.

sources.title: Rainforest Initiative — Hortus volumes index (stamped archive)
sources.author: The Rainforest Initiative
sources.note: Landing page for vols 1–12. Direct host PDFs were unstable in Oct 2026 checks — use BHL/IA for reading copies; keep this stamp for discovery notes.

sources.title: Memorial to man behind Hortus withers away
sources.author: The Hindu (Kochi)
sources.note: News report on the deteriorating Itty Achuthan memorial. Live page may be paywalled — open Wayback for full text; local PDF is a stamped research summary.

sources.title: Paira Mall collecting papers (diaries, accounts, notebooks)
sources.author: Wellcome Collection catalogue
sources.note: WHMM collecting-agent papers, 1911–1921. Local stamped PDF from the live catalogue page for offline browsing.

sources.title: Paira Mall correspondence with C.J.S. Thompson
sources.author: Wellcome Collection catalogue
sources.note: Fifteen correspondence/expense files (1910–1924) documenting Mall’s travels and collecting for Wellcome.

sources.title: Manilal English Hortus (2003) — Wellcome Library holding
sources.author: K. S. Manilal / University of Kerala
sources.note: Catalogue record for Wellcome’s open-shelf set of Manilal’s English annotated Hortus (vols 1–12).

sources.title: Hortus Indicus Malabaricus: The Eurasian Life of a Seventeenth-Century “European” Botanical Classic
sources.author: Minakshi Menon (MPIWG)
sources.note: Feature essay on Malabaricus as Dutch colonial knowledge-making and as contested cultural property in Kerala today.

sources.title: A Kerala Botanist’s Affair With an Unlikely 17th Century Book
sources.author: Akshai Jain (The Wire Science)
sources.note: Long-form profile of K.S. Manilal’s decades with Hortus — caste, translation, and IP themes in accessible prose.

sources.title: Method note: Stamping a URL into a research PDF (page-1 provenance)
sources.author: Infinity Foundation — library practice
